case_title: State of Madhya Pradesh v. Mahendra Alias Golu
neutral_facts: The accused lured two minor girls, aged 9 and 8 years, with promises of money and took them to his house. He closed the doors, undressed the girls, and rubbed his genitals against theirs. The girls became scared and cried, and the accused threatened them with physical harm. The girls later revealed the incident to a friend, leading to the filing of an FIR. The trial court convicted the accused under Section 376(2)(f) read with Section 511. The high court modified the conviction to Section 354 and reduced the sentence. The supreme court upheld the trial court's conviction for attempting to commit rape.
